svg.title: Conflicts and decision level against steps for the DPLL and CDCL solvers on the pigeonhole formula with six pigeons and five holes
svg.text: Can 6 pigeons each have their own hole among 5 holes? No: two SAT solvers prove it, one step at a time

g.text: decision level (how deep the search is)

svg.text: A conflict is a dead end: the choices made so far cannot all be right. DPLL backs up and tries again; CDCL also learns a rule from each dead end.
